description: This file is a Perl test script using Test2::V0 and Test::Coocook modules to perform functional tests on a web application, including navigation, form submissions, and content verification related to organization lifecycle management.

classes.name: Test::Coocook
classes.description: A testing class providing methods for web application testing, such as navigation, form submission, and content verification.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Test::Coocook object.

methods.name: get_ok
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request and checks for success.

methods.name: login_ok
methods.description: Performs login with provided username and password, verifying success.

methods.name: follow_link_ok
methods.description: Follows a link identified by link text, verifying the link exists and is followed successfully.

methods.name: uri
methods.description: Returns the current URI of the web page.

methods.name: submit_form_ok
methods.description: Submits a form with specified fields and verifies success.

methods.name: status_is
methods.description: Checks that the HTTP status code matches the expected value.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Provides access to the database schema for querying.

methods.name: text_lacks
methods.description: Verifies that specific text is not present in the page content.

methods.name: text_contains
methods.description: Verifies that specific text is present in the page content.

methods.name: content_lacks
methods.description: Verifies that specific content is not present in the page.
